verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes personal approval as the acceptance condition for quota counting and publication eligibility.
The client adds the concrete rejection workflow: deficient clips are returned for correction and do not count toward the approved quota.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the submitted clips are good but still need a small fix and that required changes will be sent.

verdicts.decision_note: This is the first concrete operation of the review-and-correction path; the edited observation states only the reported review outcome.

execution.observed_behavior: The client states that the clips have been approved and can now go live.

verdicts.decision_note: This is the first concrete approval and publication authorization after the correction path; the edited observation is directly entailed by the source.
The 45-second threshold changes the clip-duration acceptance criterion, not the general approval workflow, and belongs to the narrower duration Requirement.

missing_event_candidates.description: The client sets a 45-second minimum duration for clips in the next batch.
The client requires each clip in the next batch to provide full value or a complete lesson.
